title: Bump .objectui-sha past objectui f4ed2387e9 (objectui#11163, related-list actions), which also carries objectui#11199: unblocks #20936 and #20299
body:
Filing gate: **④ a coordination node.** Two held cards wait on the same `.objectui-sha` move. With one bump card, their claimants don't each move the pin. Filed by the triage seat (#6015, session `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) at its R68 retriage answer on #20936. It follows the shape of #20638 (`tooling` · `domain:devx`). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Unblocks: #20936, #20299

## Measured (REST `compare`, not a local merge-base)

- `.objectui-sha` on `main` is `db11afd4967c`.
- objectui `main` is `1cb3732ce2` as of this filing, 87 commits ahead of the pin.

| held card | its condition: the pin contains … | `compare <commit>...db11afd4967c` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #20936 (`pm:on-hold`, lint) | `f4ed2387e9`, PR objectui#11263 (objectui#11163) | `behind`, `behind_by=81` |
| #20299 (`pm:on-hold`) | `f8334f8777`, PR objectui#11215 (objectui#11199) | `behind`, `behind_by=50` |

⇒ **The target:** any objectui `main` commit that contains both. objectui `main` at claim time is recommended. ⛔ Not a commit behind either of them.

- **Later riders** (not conditions of this card): objectui#11270, `record_related` on related-list rows, is `pm:queue` in objectui. objectui#11253 is the Studio choice-field guard that #20827 waits on. If either has landed by claim time, the same bump carries it, and the claim names it.

## What the bump carries (the #20436 / #20638 precedent)

- **The pin move itself,** with the lockstep re-record and the re-measured pin citations.
- **A boot of the console built by `scripts/build-console.sh` at the new pin,** driven past first-run registration. A pin can build and still fail at boot (PR #20436).
- **The spec compatibility of the new pin:** objectui's `main` now depends on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 faces. Any objectui change that needs an unreleased spec is named, not papered over.

## After it lands

- #20936 goes `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`.
- #20299 is re-read against its own `Restart-when:` and freed.
